category5.design: The injected code removes whitespace skipping in tokenize(), so N whitespace bytes allocate N 32-byte Error tokens; with a fixed -rss_limit_mb=2048 the vulnerable build's token vector asks libFuzzer for a >2 GiB allocation and libFuzzer prints 'out-of-memory', while the secure build skips the whitespace in O(n) and exits 0. An OOM is the only observable (script_fuzzer swallows parser exceptions), so the oracle matches the libFuzzer OOM line; the limit is fixed in argv so it is identical on both builds.
